text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 9, 2024) for 2314 Islington Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 9, 2024) for 2314 Islington Avenue, Folder Number 24 209328 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to December 1, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
